notes.title: 7/3 Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the incomplete display of the main interface
2. Fixed the price reversal of black tea and green tea
3. Fixed the game problem caused by win10 scaling
4. Fixed the game achievement system. Now the game can trigger achievements normally

If you are using extended content, you may need to re-install it after the game is updated.
